scope: Business packages (packages/*/src) and apps (apps/*/src) Vue components. The component library (packages/ui-vue-shadcn), specs, stories and __stories__ fixtures are out of scope.
rule: Business code may render a native <button>, <input> or <textarea> only when the component itself is the implementation of that interaction surface (tile, row, tree node, calendar cell, segmented control, window chrome) or when it is a hidden file input opened by a component-library control. Everything that triggers an ordinary action or edits a form value must compose the ui-vue-shadcn component or a wrapper of it. type="hidden" inputs are not UI controls and are out of scope. type="file" inputs are allowed only when hidden and triggered from a library control. Every remaining native control is registered below with a reason; unregistered native controls fail the governance test.

exceptions.reason: Minimal number-input atom for standalone Desktop windows; custom snooze retains native numeric validation and keyboard interaction without loading the authenticated shell runtime.
Minimal window-chrome button atom shared by the standalone intervention and custom-notification windows; it is the interaction surface implementation, not a page action.
Standalone authentication window chrome; window controls are host behaviour with their own styling.
Standalone focus window chrome; window and session actions use the window visual layer.
